instruction: Update the folder name from 'meeting_notes_draft' to 'meeting_notes_final' on your Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Rename folder with status change pattern (meeting_notes_draft -> meeting_notes_final). Similar difficulty to original - simple folder rename operation on Desktop. Evaluator checks if renamed folder exists using shell command.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator correctly checks BOTH required conditions for rename operation
Condition 1: Target folder exists - '[ -d ~/Desktop/meeting_notes_final ]' verifies the new folder exists
Condition 2: Source folder removed - '[ ! -d ~/Desktop/meeting_notes_draft ]' verifies the old folder no longer exists
Correct logical flow: Both conditions connected with && operator ensure BOTH must be true for success
Prevents false positives: Would correctly fail if folder was copied (source still exists) or if target was created without removing source
Metric logic correct: exact_match properly compares command output to expected 'Renamed successfully.\n'
